## Description
A concise summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature or command (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] New agent adapter or profile
- [ ] New or improved standardized skill
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing configurations to behave differently)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification & Testing
Describe the tests you ran to verify your changes:
- [ ] Ran automated pytest suite (`pytest`)
- [ ] Tested CLI commands manually on test workspace
- [ ] Verified adapter output matches target agent specifications
- [ ] Verified no unmanaged files were overwritten

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards.
- [ ] I have added automated tests for my changes.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `docs/`.
